# freshdesk_notification_bcc (Resource)

Addresses blind-copied on every outgoing notification, typically for archiving.

~> This is a singleton: only one instance should exist. Destroying it clears the address list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A singleton: only one of these should exist per helpdesk.
resource "freshdesk_notification_bcc" "this" {
  emails = ["archive@example.com"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `emails` (Set of String) Addresses to blind-copy. An empty set disables the feature.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always `freshdesk`; this list is account-wide.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# This list is account-wide, so any ID imports it.
terraform import freshdesk_notification_bcc.this freshdesk
```
